name: Jonathan J. Tuggle
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
education: Mercer University Walter F. George School of Law
about: Attorney Jonathan J. Tuggle is a founding shareholder of Boyd Collar Nolen Tuggle & Roddenbery, an Atlanta, Georgia, based law firm dedicated to domestic relations and family law matters. In his practice, he represents clients through a broad spectrum of challenging legal issues, including alimony, divorce proceedings, child custody, child support, prenuptial agreements, adoption and annulment cases. He also assists individuals seeking safety and peace of mind by facilitating the enforcement of protective orders against domestic violence.

With over two decades of experience handling sensitive personal matters, Mr. Tuggle brings a compassionate yet strategic approach to domestic relations litigation and dispute resolution. He works closely with clients to guide them through complex domestic challenges while maintaining a strong commitment to protecting their legal rights and family dynamic. His comprehensive background allows him to navigate intricate emotional and financial aspects of family law cases effectively.

Mr. Tuggle’s educational foundation began at the University of Georgia, where he earned a Bachelor of Business Administration degree in 1995. He went on to pursue his legal training at Mercer University School of Law, earning his Juris Doctor in 1998.

Admitted to practice law in Georgia in 1998, Mr. Tuggle has earned high regard across the legal community for his professional standards and ethical conduct. He holds an AV Preeminent* peer-review rating through Martindale-Hubbell, reflecting the highest level of professional distinction and peer recognition in the legal field.

Beyond his practice, Mr. Tuggle actively contributes to the professional legal community and local civic organizations. In 2019, he was inducted as a Fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers. He has served as Past President of the Weltner Family Law Inn of Court and maintains memberships in several legal associations, including the Lawyers Club of Atlanta, the Old War Horse Lawyers Club, the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association, the Cobb County Bar Association and the Atlanta Bar Association.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
